notes: Sikora et al. 2011 JBC, V. cholerae N16961 T2 secretome (doi:10.1074/jbc.M110.211078, PMID 21385872). Quote "three hypothetical proteins encoded by VCA0583, VCA0738, and VC2298" is verbatim in abstract; listed among 16 new T2S substrates from proteomic analysis of the El Tor N16961 T2S secretome. Organism exact match.

Same ref (doi:10.1074/jbc.M110.211078, PMID 21385872). Quote "16 new putative T2S substrates, including sialidase, several proteins participating in chitin utilization, two aminopeptidases, TagA-related protein, cytolysin" verbatim in abstract. TagA-related protein among proteomically identified T2S substrates of N16961. Organism exact match.

Filloux 2011 Front Microbiol review (doi:10.3389/fmicb.2011.00155, PMID 21811488). Quote "there is only one Hxc-dependent substrate, namely LapA, known as low-molecular weight alkaline phosphatase (Ball et al.,)" verbatim in full text. LapA (PA0688) listed in Table as Hxc T2SS substrate; secretion Hxc-dependent. Organism P. aeruginosa PAO1 match. Review citing Ball et al. as primary, but explicitly documents Hxc(T2SS)-dependent secretion.

Same Filloux 2011 review (doi:10.3389/fmicb.2011.00155, PMID 21811488). Quote "achieves the secretion of all Xcp substrates but the aminopeptidase PaAP (Michel et al.,). This is another indication of a specific interaction between the XcpP/XcpQ-like subcomplex and T2SS substrates." verbatim in full text. PaAP (PA2939) listed in Table as Xcp T2SS aminopeptidase substrate. Organism PAO1 match.

Flieger et al. 2002 Infect Immun (doi:10.1128/IAI.70.11.6094-6106.2002, PMID 12379686). Quote joins two verbatim abstract spans via ellipsis: "We previously showed that Legionella pneumophila secretes, via its type II secretion system, phospholipase A activities..." and "...we identified and characterized plaA, a gene encoding a phospholipase A that cleaves fatty acids from lysophospholipids." Both verbatim. plaA mutant supernatants lose >80% lysophospholipase A; T2SS secretion documented. L. pneumophila strain match.

Letellier, Howard & Buckley 1997 JBC (doi:10.1074/jbc.272.17.11109, PMID 9111006; no PMCID, abstract via Europe PMC). Quote "Aeromonas spp. secrete the channel-forming protein proaerolysin across their inner and outer membranes in separate steps using the general secretion pathway." is verbatim opening sentence. proaerolysin = AerA/aerolysin (P09167); general secretion pathway = T2SS; documents secretion across outer membrane. Paper studies A. hydrophila + A. salmonicida; row is A. hydrophila ATCC 7966, match.

DuMont, Karaba & Cianciotto 2015 Infect Immun (doi:10.1128/IAI.00672-15, PMID 26169274). Quote "the serine proteases StmPr1 and StmPr2, which were confirmed to be Xps substrates, are predominantly responsible for secreted proteolytic activities exhibited by strain K279a" verbatim in abstract. Xps = type II secretion system; StmPr1 confirmed Xps substrate. S. maltophilia K279a exact match.

Shevchik, Robert-Baudouy & Hugouvieux-Cotte-Pattat 1997 J Bacteriol (doi:10.1128/jb.179.23.7321-7330.1997, PMID 9393696). Quote "PelI is an extracellular protein secreted by the Out secretory pathway of E. chrysanthemi." verbatim in abstract. Out system = T2SS. Organism: paper says Erwinia chrysanthemi 3937, which is the same strain now reclassified as Dickeya dadantii 3937 (identical strain, genus renamed) -> organism_match=yes.
